organization_note: AI Singapore is a national programme; its site calls it a national initiative driven by the Ministry of Digital Development and Information, the Infocomm Media Development Authority, and the National Research Foundation, Singapore, and hosted by the National University of Singapore and Nanyang Technological University. The pages reviewed name no separate legal entity. Its Products Pillar anchors SEA-LION, the open-source project that develops the models, which AI Singapore publishes under its Hugging Face organization.
